title: Advertisement from Dr. Eduard Kaiser's Institut für Mikroskopie
citation: Eduard Kaiser, advertisement from Dr. Eduard Kaiser's Institut für Mikroskopie, Zeitschrift für Mikrobiologie 1 (1877).
tags: Germany; Berlin; Eduard Kaiser; commercial preparations; slide trade; surviving slides; institute
note: A full-page advertisement from the first volume of Kaiser's Zeitschrift für Mikrobiologie lists mounted specimens available from his newly established Institut für Mikroskopie. Surviving slides bearing the original Friedenstrasse address independently tie the advertised business to physical preparations, making this a strong commerce-to-object bridge.

title: Preis-Verzeichniss mikroskopischer Präparate, Utensilien und Materialien zur Anfertigung derselben
citation: Johann Diedrich Möller, Preis-Verzeichniss mikroskopischer Präparate, Utensilien und Materialien zur Anfertigung derselben (Berlin: G. W. F. Müller, 1877), 36 pp.
tags: Germany; J.D. Möller; diatoms; slide trade; price list; mounting materials; commercial preparations
note: A later, expanded edition of Möller's dedicated slide-and-materials price catalogue. It is kept separately from the already-listed 1868 edition because the catalogue was an evolving commercial instrument and the 1877 issue documents a later state of the product range.

title: Mikroskopische (Duncker'sche) Praeparate
citation: J. Klönne and G. Müller, “Mikroskopische (Duncker'sche) Praeparate,” advertisement in Hermann Hager, Das Mikroskop und seine Anwendung, 6th ed. (Berlin: Julius Springer, 1879), publisher advertisements at end of volume.
tags: Germany; Berlin; Klönne; Müller; Duncker; commercial preparations; price list; slide trade
note: A direct commercial advertisement for prepared microscope slides from Klönne & Müller's Institut für Mikroskopie, Berlin S., Prinzenstr. 56. It explicitly advertises 'Duncker'sche' microscopic preparations together with microscopes, utensils and materials and offers a price list gratis and post-free.

title: Verzeichniss der von Otto Bachmann's Laboratorium für Mikroskopie in Landsberg am Lech (Bayern) zu beziehenden Mikroskopischen Präparate
citation: Otto Bachmann, Verzeichniss der von Otto Bachmann's Laboratorium für Mikroskopie in Landsberg am Lech (Bayern) zu beziehenden Mikroskopischen Präparate (Kaufbeuren: Buchdruckerei von J. B. Dorn, 1880).
tags: Germany; Bavaria; Otto Bachmann; teaching; commercial preparations; slide formats; pricing; schools
note: An unusually rich slide-trade catalogue. Bachmann states that most preparations were designed as demonstration material for natural-history teaching in secondary schools; he specifies English-format 76 x 26 mm slides, an alternative Giessen format, labelled mounts, protective cartons, approval shipments and replacement terms, and gives category-specific prices. It directly joins manufacture, school use, standardization, packaging and commerce.
links: Reproduced catalogue in Francisco de Arruda Furtado correspondence edition: https://livrozilla.com/doc/494969/-2002---correspond%C3%AAncia-cient%C3%ADfica-de-francisco-de-arruda...

title: Preis-Verzeichniss mikroskopischer Präparate, Utensilien und Materialien zur Anfertigung derselben
citation: Johann Diedrich Möller, Preis-Verzeichniss mikroskopischer Präparate, Utensilien und Materialien zur Anfertigung derselben (Berlin: G. W. F. Müller, 1883), 40 pp.
tags: Germany; J.D. Möller; diatoms; slide trade; price list; mounting materials; commercial preparations
note: Another documented edition of Möller's specialist catalogue, now forty pages. Retaining dated editions makes it possible to reconstruct changes in the commercial preparation programme rather than treating the 1868 catalogue as a timeless list.

title: Preis-Verzeichniss Mikroskopischer Präparate von Diatomeen in Einzelpräparaten, Sammelpräparaten, Test-platten, Typenplatten und Salonpräparaten sowie von Foraminiferen, Polycistinen und Spongiolithen
citation: J. Klönne and G. Müller, Preis-Verzeichniss Mikroskopischer Präparate von Diatomeen in Einzelpräparaten, Sammelpräparaten, Test-platten, Typenplatten und Salonpräparaten sowie von Foraminiferen, Polycistinen und Spongiolithen (Berlin: Institut für Herstellung achromatischer Mikroscope und mikroskopischer Präparate, 1885), 32 pp.
tags: Germany; Berlin; Klönne; Müller; diatoms; test plates; type plates; arranged slides; foraminifera; radiolaria; trade
note: A highly slide-specific Berlin catalogue that differentiates single mounts, collective mounts, test plates, type plates and salon preparations and extends the offer to foraminifera, polycystines and sponge spicules. It is especially useful for reconstructing commercial categories of slide objects, not merely taxa.

title: Beiträge zur Technik mikroskopischer Dauerpräparate von Süsswasseralgen
citation: Ludwig Klein, “Beiträge zur Technik mikroskopischer Dauerpräparate von Süsswasseralgen,” Hedwigia 27 (1888): 114–120.
tags: Germany; freshwater algae; permanent slides; mounting technique; preparation; botany
note: A dedicated technical paper on making permanent freshwater-algae preparations. BHL indexes the article as a discrete contribution in Hedwigia, and library catalogues also preserve it as a six-page offprint. It belongs because the production of durable slide preparations is the paper's explicit subject.

title: Beiträge zur Technik mikroskopischer Dauerpräparate von Süsswasseralgen II
citation: Ludwig Klein, “Beiträge zur Technik mikroskopischer Dauerpräparate von Süsswasseralgen II,” Zeitschrift für wissenschaftliche Mikroskopie und für mikroskopische Technik 5 (1888): 456–464.
tags: Germany; freshwater algae; permanent slides; mounting technique; preparation; marking; selection
note: Continuation of Klein's Hedwigia paper, extending the practical method for permanent algal preparations. Contemporary bibliographic reporting identifies it as a continuation and notes the use of Winkel's marking apparatus and methods for selecting individual forms from mixed material.
links: Contemporary bibliographic reference preserved in later technical literature: https://eurekamag.com/research/022/529/022529529.php

title: Preis-Verzeichniss mikroskopischer Präparate, Utensilien und Materialien zur Anfertigung derselben
citation: Johann Diedrich Möller, Preis-Verzeichniss mikroskopischer Präparate, Utensilien und Materialien zur Anfertigung derselben (Berlin: G. W. F. Müller, 1889), 40 pp.
tags: Germany; J.D. Möller; diatoms; slide trade; price list; mounting materials; commercial preparations
note: A late-1880s state of the Möller commercial catalogue, independently cited in recent diatom scholarship. It provides a dated point between the 1883 list and the 1890s atlas/index and 1897 price list.

title: Lichtdrucktafeln hervorragend schöner und vollständiger Möller'scher Diatomaceen-Präparate
citation: Johann Diedrich Möller, Lichtdrucktafeln hervorragend schöner und vollständiger Möller'scher Diatomaceen-Präparate (Wedel in Holstein: Selbstverlag des Herausgebers, 1891), 59 leaves of plates.
tags: Germany; J.D. Möller; diatoms; arranged slides; phototype plates; object-text; self-publishing
note: A plate publication built directly around Möller's physical diatom preparations. The fifty-nine leaves reproduce the organized slide preparations and were issued with a separate 1892 species index, making this one of the clearest German object-to-publication systems in the bibliography.

title: Verzeichniss der in den Lichtdrucktafeln Möller'scher Diatomaceen-Präparate enthaltenen Arten
citation: Johann Diedrich Möller, Verzeichniss der in den Lichtdrucktafeln Möller'scher Diatomaceen-Präparate enthaltenen Arten (Wedel in Holstein: Selbstverlag des Herausgebers, 1892), x + 176 pp.
tags: Germany; J.D. Möller; diatoms; slide index; object-text; catalogue; provenance
note: The 176-page companion index to Möller's 1891 phototype atlas. It binds the depicted preparation plates to named diatom taxa and therefore functions as a textual index to a physical-slide publication system rather than as a general diatom treatise.

title: Preisverzeichniss mikroskopischer Präparate, Utensilien und Materialien zur Anfertigung derselben
citation: Johann Diedrich Möller, Preisverzeichniss mikroskopischer Präparate, Utensilien und Materialien zur Anfertigung derselben (Berlin: G. W. F. Müller, 1897), 52 pp.
tags: Germany; J.D. Möller; diatoms; slide trade; price list; mounting materials; commercial preparations
note: The longest nineteenth-century Möller price-list edition identified in this pass, at fifty-two pages. Read with the 1868, 1877, 1883 and 1889 editions, it establishes the catalogue itself as a serial commercial record of the preparation business.

title: Hermann Welcker (1822–1897) – seine anatomischen Präparate und Modelle
citation: Andreas Heller, Hermann Welcker (1822–1897) – seine anatomischen Präparate und Modelle (doctoral dissertation, Martin-Luther-Universität Halle-Wittenberg, 2007).
tags: Germany; Halle; Hermann Welcker; surviving slides; teaching preparations; research preparations; collection recovery; provenance
note: Object-led reconstruction of Welcker's surviving preparations and models. The study separates teaching and research preparations, discusses their development and use, and explicitly reports that large parts of Welcker's microscopic preparation collection were rediscovered. It supplies a German university-collection counterpart to the commercial catalogues in this module.

title: Trichinellas Wanderwege: Entdeckungsgeschichte eines Parasiten auf Objektträgern
citation: Beate Kunst, “Trichinellas Wanderwege: Entdeckungsgeschichte eines Parasiten auf Objektträgern,” in Beate Kunst, Thomas Schnalke, and Gottfried Bogusch (eds.), Der zweite Blick: Besondere Objekte aus den historischen Sammlungen der Charité (Berlin: De Gruyter, 2010), 219–234.
tags: Germany; Berlin; Charité; Rudolf Virchow; trichinella; histological slides; surviving slides; provenance; object history
note: A literal object-history chapter organized around microscope slides. It begins from surviving Virchow-associated Trichinella slides and reconstructs their evidentiary, institutional and collection histories, making the glass mounts themselves the historical problem.
links: Berliner Medizinhistorisches Museum: https://bmm-charite.de/kontakt/beate-kunst; De Gruyter contents: https://www.degruyter.com/document/doi/10.1515/9783110226973/html
